acceptance_criteria.criterion: WorkPackageSummarySchema includes active_pipeline_stages (array of strings, nullable, optional)
Existing ledger JSON without these fields parses successfully
TypeScript compilation succeeds with no errors

summary: Added three new schema fields to root-index.ts: synthesis_generated_at (string, nullable, optional) and ledger_version (string, optional) to RootIndexSchema; active_pipeline_stages (array of strings, nullable, optional) to WorkPackageSummarySchema. All changes are additive with .optional()/.nullable() — fully backward compatible. TypeScript compilation clean, all 57 schema tests pass.

comments.note: The WorkPackageSummarySchema active_pipeline_stages field uses z.array(z.string()) instead of z.array(PipelineType). Using the PipelineType enum would give stronger typing, but since the spec defines the field as 'array of strings' for forward-compatibility with future pipeline types, string is the correct choice here.

summary: All 5 acceptance criteria verified and passed. TypeScript compilation clean (tsc --noEmit, 0 errors). Schema tests: 57/57 pass. Full regression: 1309/1309 tests pass across 42 test files. Three new fields confirmed in root-index.ts: synthesis_generated_at (z.string().nullable().optional()), ledger_version (z.string().optional()), active_pipeline_stages (z.array(z.string()).nullable().optional()). Backward compatibility confirmed by existing minimalRootIndex and minimalWpSummary fixture tests which omit the new fields. One pre-existing unhandled error in GUI test suite (jsdom missing) is unrelated to this WP.

comments.note: Pre-existing unrelated issue: tests/gui/client-rendering.test.ts fails to start due to missing jsdom package. This predates WP-001 and is unrelated to the schema changes. Recommend installing jsdom as a dev dependency when GUI test coverage is prioritised.

The existing project-archiving-schema.test.ts and work-package-schema.test.ts fixtures (minimalRootIndex, minimalWpSummary) implicitly cover AC4 (backward compatibility) since they omit all three new fields and still parse successfully. No additional backward-compat test is needed.

summary: Reviewed mcp-server/src/schema/root-index.ts. All three schema additions are correct, minimal, and spec-compliant. Field typing is semantically precise: synthesis_generated_at correctly uses .nullable().optional() (explicit null = invalidated, absent = not yet set); ledger_version uses .optional() only (never explicitly null); active_pipeline_stages uses .nullable().optional() with z.array(z.string()) — the string element type is the right forward-compat choice over z.array(PipelineType). Field placement is logical (grouped with synthesis fields). No blocking issues found.

comments.note: Test coverage gap: no explicit positive-path tests for the new fields (e.g., asserting that synthesis_generated_at: null, ledger_version: '2.4.0', and active_pipeline_stages: ['implementation'] parse correctly and round-trip through the schemas). The implicit backward-compat coverage from minimalRootIndex/minimalWpSummary fixtures is sufficient for this WP, but targeted positive tests would strengthen regression protection. Recommend adding them in a future schema-hardening task.

synthesis_generated_at and ledger_version use z.string() without format enforcement (.datetime() or a semver regex respectively). This is intentional and consistent with existing fields like date_created: z.string(). Acceptable as-is; candidate for a future schema-validation hardening pass if stricter input guarantees are desired.

summary: Updated mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md to reflect the three new schema fields added in WP-001. Added synthesis_generated_at?: string | null and ledger_version?: string to the RootIndex interface definition; added active_pipeline_stages?: string[] | null to the WorkPackageSummary interface definition. The constraints.md and data-flows.md documents required no changes — they reference these fields contextually at the behaviour level and were already consistent with the implementation.

notes: WP-001 schema additions are approved. Three fields added correctly to root-index.ts: synthesis_generated_at (string|null|undefined), ledger_version (string|undefined), active_pipeline_stages (string[]|null|undefined). All backward compatible. No issues found — Documentation agent may proceed.
